summary.en: The poster faces from the peak albums. Later members remain "the other drummer" forever.
summary.zh: 巅峰专辑海报上的那几张脸。后来的人巡演二十年，仍是「另一位鼓手」。

body.en:
Fans remember a T-shirt more than a chronology. Four faces locked to one album cycle—Zeppelin around IV, Sabbath with Ozzy—and that cast becomes "the real band."

It is unfair and commercially inevitable. Peak chemistry sells merch; Wikipedia arguments freeze it. We name lineup versions so you can use the myth without erasing every other cast.
body.zh:
粉丝记得 T 恤，多过年表。四张脸锁在一轮专辑上——Zeppelin 的 IV 前后，Sabbath 的 Ozzy 卡司——这就是「真乐队」。

不公平，但好卖。巅峰化学反应出周边；维基吵架把它冻住。我们把经典阵容写成带年份的版本：神话可用，其它卡司也不用抹掉。

note.en: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham—one public image.
note.zh: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham——一张公共脸。

note.en: Ozzy era vs Dio era: two "classic" wars in one logo.
note.zh: Ozzy 期 vs Dio 期：一个 logo 里两场「经典」战争。
